a_eps3.expr: cross_mean(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 0.001))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 0.001)))), 20)

a_sum.expr: cross_mean(add(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), 20)

a_up.expr: cross_mean(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), 20)
a_up.why: 只留上侧 up_ratio(原 ε)。如果预测力来自「上尾相对下尾」这个差,单侧应明显弱于原式;x1 的 numpy 版说上侧单独就不弱(rank IC 0.038)

a_dn.expr: cross_mean(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), 20)
a_dn.why: 只留下侧 dn_ratio(原 ε)。若下侧是原式里的噪声项(方向与上侧相同却被减掉),它单独应当方向为 − 且弱于上侧

a_1m.expr: cross_mean(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), Ret, create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(Ret), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), 20)

a_q5.why: H7 的另一半:阈值和分母都换成 5 分钟收益自己的分位数(同一尺度的 ES/VaR 比之差)。5 分钟收益为 0 的分钟更少,爆炸日应减少;若空头腿随之下降,空头腿靠的是事件记忆而不是尾部形状

a_evt.why: 只留事件记忆:过去 20 天里「q95 = 0 或 q05 = 0」的天数(封板日计数;+1e-6 只为把整型掩码变成浮点)。若原式的空头腿主要是它,这个计数的空头腿应不低于原式;它取值只有几档,预期过不了 dist 门槛,只作诊断

a_sig.expr: cross_mean(div(sub(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), day_std(Ret)), 20)

b_lvl.expr: cross_mean(div(add(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), day_std(Ret)), 20)
